name: google_workspace_mcp-d8369122-blind11-v1-ots
instr:
# google_workspace_mcp: repairing Google Workspace MCP misbehaviour without a test suite

I point an assistant at this server, which acts on someone's mail, documents, tabular files and calendar for them. After picking up the latest build, everyday operations across all of it started returning wrong answers or failing outright. Nothing about the remote services changed and nothing about my own calls changed. The repository has received 11 separate undocumented edits. They are clearly independent of one another, so please do not stop after finding one cause.

Deciding whether a signed-in person may do something. The test of whether what they granted covers what an operation needs now answers backwards in every case I tried. A broad grant no longer counts as covering its narrower relatives: full mail access is reported as *not* covering read-only, sending, labelling or composing, singly or several at once; full file access is reported as not covering the narrower file-creation and read-only forms; write access to the calendar, to the address book and to tabular files is reported as not covering its read-only counterpart; and neither is a request mixing one exact match with one implied. In the other direction it is far too generous: something never granted at all comes back reported as covered, and so does a request checked against an empty list of grants or against none at all.
